## assistant
Committed as `bae9200`. Build, typecheck, and lint all pass.

## What I found and fixed

The contract and the page's feature set were fine; almost everything else was broken or left as template scaffolding.

**Transaction flow — the worst of it.** `/payouts` used raw wagmi `useWriteContract`, which resolves on wallet signature, not confirmation. It never read the allowance at all, and showed Approve and Send Payout side by side, both always enabled. A user could hit Send without approving (revert), or double-approve freely. Rewrote around `useScaffoldWriteContract` with a strict one-CTA-at-a-time ladder (Connect → Switch to Base → Approve → Send), the approve button locked by both `approvalSubmitting` (released in `finally`, so rejections unlock it) and `approveCooldown` (through the allowance refetch). There was also no in-form network check — only the header dropdown — so a wrong-chain user could click through into a silent wagmi error; the primary button now becomes a `useSwitchChain` "Switch to Base".

**USDC was registered in `deployedContracts.ts`**, which `yarn deploy` regenerates from scratch. The next deploy would have silently wiped it and broken every USDC read/write. Moved to `externalContracts.ts`.

**Event history scanned from block 0** on Base mainnet — ~34M blocks. Scoped to the contract's deploy block (`33712450`, from the deployment metadata).

**Config:** `pollingInterval` was 30000 on an L2 with 2s blocks; now 3000. Removed the bare `http()` fallback transport that fans out to public RPCs, added a `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_RPC_URL` override. Disabled burner wallets (real USDC), added Phantom, hid Debug Contracts on live networks.

**UI:** raw text input for the recipient → `<AddressInput/>`; contract address now shown via `<Address/>` (it appeared nowhere); USD values on every amount; hardcoded `bg-black text-white` → `bg-base-200 text-base-content` so the theme toggle works; DaisyUI's `loading` class (which blanks the button) → inline spinner; `--radius-field` 9999rem → 0.5rem; errors now toast instead of `console.error` only.

**Branding:** title, description, favicon, logo, manifest, footer links, header, landing page, README — all still SE2 defaults. Replaced. OG images now build off `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` so they're absolute.

**One thing worth calling out:** `yarn next:build` failed on the baseline commit too, so this shipped un-buildable. Next 16's prerender workers expose a non-functional `localStorage` global; RainbowKit's `typeof localStorage !== "undefined"` check passes and then crashes on `.getItem`. I drop the broken global on the server (`utils/dropBrokenServerLocalStorage.ts`, imported from the root layout — `instrumentation.ts` runs too late for those workers). This is a library/framework incompatibility, not contractor code, and is worth revisiting when RainbowKit fixes the guard upstream.

## Not done — needs your credentials or hosting access

- **Contract verification on Basescan.** `yarn verify --network base` needs `ETHERSCAN_API_KEY` and network access. This is ship-blocking per the audit — an unverified contract handling real USDC is a trust problem. Please run it before launch.
- **Env vars on the host.** I wired up `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_RPC_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_ALCHEMY_API_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` (all documented in the README and `.env.example`), but I can't set or confirm them on Vercel. Unset, the app falls back to Scaffold-ETH's shared rate-limited demo key and demo WalletConnect project, and OG images will point at `localhost`.
- **Mobile deep linking is implemented but untested** — it needs a real phone and a WalletConnect session.
- The favicon and logo are a plain placeholder mark I generated (blue rounded square, white arrow); swap in real brand assets if you have them.
